vb_textbox.text: using your "s" and "k" keys, you have 1.5 seconds to select a gnome. s equals the left gnome and your k key equals the right gnome. a screen will appear. on this screen, either a red or yellow basket will appear. as soon as you see a basket, press your space bar" note that some gnome pairs give lesser rewards than others, for example the small purple and bland gnome give low value. in my experience select the s key if the purple gnome is to your left.
